name: plaintext
strip_regex: (?m)^\s*(?:To unsubscribe|Unsubscribe|This message was sent to|This email was sent to)\b.*$
notes: The catch all for hotel and other confirmations that arrive as a text body. It has no sender domains, so it is only reached when no vendor matched by domain and no other subject pattern matched. Removed: an unsubscribe footer line, if the message has one. Kept verbatim: everything else, including the From, Date and Subject headers, which the packet renders as a monospace block. The amount pattern reads the mandatory fee that the guest settles at the desk, not the room rate, because a room booked by the company is not the claim.
